gloss: to order; to place an order; to request

definitions.gloss: to order; to place an order (for goods, food, services)
definitions.explanation: To request the purchase or preparation of goods, food, or services. The most common everyday meaning.

definitions.gloss: to make demands; to impose conditions; to make requests
definitions.explanation: To specify requirements or make particular demands. Often implies being particular or picky about how something should be done.

notes:
One of the most essential words for daily life in Japan — used at restaurants, shops, and online. The noun ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ is extremely common on its own. Sense 2 uses the expression ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to attach demands/conditions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take an order
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}{品|ひん}→注文品：08964_chuumonhin⟧: ordered item
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: order number
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to make demands, to specify conditions
- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: special order, custom order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発注|はっちゅう}→発注：05132_hacchuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to place an order — business/commercial context, for placing orders with suppliers
- ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to order; to ask — more casual (used at restaurants informally)
- オーダー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to order — English loanword, common in fashion and food service
